ko.title: [마케팅 101 #11] 같은 약이 이름만 붙으면 왜 2배 비싼가

segments.src: > A brand is a promise stored in someone's head — and brand management is the work of building that promise, keeping it consistent, and knowing how far you can stretch it before it snaps.
segments.tr: > 브랜드는 누군가의 머리 속에 저장된 약속이다 — 브랜드 관리는 그 약속을 만들고, 일관되게 유지하고, 언제까지 늘릴 수 있을지 알아야 하는 일이다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Walk into any store and you'll find two products that are physically close to identical, sitting side by side, with very different price tags.
segments.tr: 아무 가게에 가든 물리적으로 거의 같은 두 제품이 나란히 놓여 있는데, 가격표가 크게 다르다.

segments.src: Nothing about the atoms explains the gap.
segments.tr: 분자 수준에서는 그 차이를 설명할 수 없다.

segments.src: Something about the *name* does.
segments.tr: *이름*이 그 차이를 설명한다.

segments.src: That gap has a name in marketing: **brand equity** — the extra value a brand name adds beyond what the product itself delivers.
segments.tr: 그 차이를 마케팅에서는 **브랜드 자산**이라고 부른다 — 브랜드 이름이 제품 자체가 제공하는 것 이상으로 더하는 추가 가치다.

segments.src: One rough way to picture it:
segments.tr: 이를 대략적으로 이해하는 한 가지 방법:

segments.src: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version
segments.tr: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version

segments.src: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version
segments.tr: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version

segments.src: That's a simplification (equity also shows up as loyalty, bargaining power with retailers, and cheaper customer acquisition), but it makes the idea concrete: equity is measurable, and it lives in the customer's mind, not on the factory floor.
segments.tr: 이건 단순화한 것이다(자산은 또한 충성도, 소매업체와의 협상력, 저렴한 고객 획득으로도 나타난다), 하지만 이 아이디어를 구체적으로 보여준다: 자산은 측정 가능하고, 공장 바닥이 아니라 고객의 머리 속에 존재한다.

segments.src: Marketing academics usually break brand equity into four building blocks, following David Aaker's well-known model:
segments.tr: 마케팅 학자들은 보통 David Aaker의 유명한 모델에 따라 브랜드 자산을 네 가지 구성 요소로 나눈다:

segments.src: - **Awareness** — do people know you exist, and do you come to mind first?
segments.tr: - **인지도** — 사람들이 당신의 존재를 알고 있는가, 그리고 당신이 가장 먼저 떠오르는가?

segments.src: - **Perceived quality** — do they believe you're good, whether or not lab tests agree?
segments.tr: - **지각된 품질** — 실험실 테스트가 동의하든 안 하든 사람들은 당신이 좋다고 믿는가?

segments.src: - **Associations** — what images, feelings, and situations attach to the name?
segments.tr: - **연관성** — 이름에 어떤 이미지, 감정, 상황이 붙어 있는가?

segments.src: - **Loyalty** — will they buy you again when a cheaper option is right there?
segments.tr: - **충성도** — 더 저렴한 선택지가 있을 때도 다시 당신을 구매할 것인가?

segments.src: Now, the second concept.
segments.tr: 이제 두 번째 개념이다.

segments.src: **Brand identity** is what the company *intends* the brand to stand for — the positioning, the personality, the visual system, the tone.
segments.tr: **브랜드 정체성**은 회사가 브랜드로 *의도하는* 의미다 — 포지셔닝, 개성, 시각 시스템, 톤.

segments.src: **Brand image** is what customers *actually* believe.
segments.tr: **브랜드 이미지**는 고객들이 *실제로* 믿는 의미다.

segments.src: Those two are rarely the same thing, and closing the gap is most of a brand manager's job.
segments.tr: 이 둘은 좀처럼 같은 것이 아니며, 그 차이를 좁히는 것이 브랜드 매니저 업무의 대부분이다.

segments.src: You control the identity.
segments.tr: 당신은 정체성을 통제한다.

segments.src: You only influence the image.
segments.tr: 당신은 이미지에만 영향을 미칠 수 있다.

segments.src: Third: **brand extension**.
segments.tr: 세 번째: **브랜드 확장**.

segments.src: Once a brand has equity, it's tempting to spend it — to launch a product in a new category under the same name and borrow the trust you've already earned.
segments.tr: 브랜드가 자산을 가지면, 그것을 사용하고 싶은 유혹이 생긴다 — 새로운 카테고리에서 같은 이름으로 제품을 출시하고 이미 얻은 신뢰를 활용하는 것이다.

segments.src: Extensions are cheap compared to building a brand from zero, and that's exactly why they're overused.
segments.tr: 확장은 처음부터 브랜드를 만드는 것보다 훨씬 저렴하고, 정확히 그래서 남용된다.

segments.src: The variable that predicts success is **perceived fit**: does the new product feel like something this brand would plausibly make?
segments.tr: 성공을 예측하는 변수는 **지각된 적합도**다: 새 제품이 이 브랜드가 그럴듯하게 만들 수 있는 것처럼 느껴지는가?

segments.src: Nike moving from shoes into athletic apparel fits.
segments.tr: 나이키가 신발에서 운동복으로 확장한 것은 맞다.

segments.src: Apple moving from computers into phones fits.
segments.tr: 애플이 컴퓨터에서 휴대폰으로 확장한 것도 맞다.

segments.src: Harley-Davidson launching a perfume in the 1990s did not fit, and it's still cited in textbooks as the cautionary tale.
segments.tr: 할리-데이비슨이 1990년대에 향수를 출시한 것은 맞지 않았고, 여전히 교과서에 경고 사례로 인용된다.

segments.src: When fit is weak, the extension usually fails — and worse, it can cause **brand dilution**, muddying the associations that made the parent brand valuable in the first place.
segments.tr: 적합도가 약하면 확장은 보통 실패한다 — 그리고 더 나쁜 것은, **브랜드 희석**을 야기할 수 있다는 것이다. 처음에 모브랜드를 가치 있게 만든 연관성을 흐리게 한다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상 생활에서

segments.src: Stand in the pain-relief aisle at a CVS or a Walgreens.
segments.tr: CVS나 Walgreens의 진통제 통로에 서 있다고 상상해보자.

segments.src: On the shelf: Tylenol Extra Strength, 500 mg acetaminophen.
segments.tr: 선반에: 타이레놀 익스트라 스트렝스, 500mg 아세트아미노펜.

segments.src: Next to it: the store's own brand — CVS Health or Walgreens — also 500 mg acetaminophen.
segments.tr: 그 옆: 가게 자체 브랜드 — CVS Health나 Walgreens — 역시 500mg 아세트아미노펜.

segments.src: Same active ingredient, same dose, both regulated by the FDA to the same standard.
segments.tr: 같은 활성 성분, 같은 용량, 둘 다 FDA에 의해 같은 기준으로 규제된다.

segments.src: The store brand often costs noticeably less per caplet; the exact spread moves with sales and store, but a several-dollar gap on a 100-count bottle is typical.
segments.tr: 가게 브랜드는 보통 캡슐당 눈에 띄게 더 저렴하다; 정확한 차이는 판매와 가게에 따라 달라지지만, 100개 병에서 몇 달러 차이는 일반적이다.

segments.src: Millions of Americans reach for the more expensive one anyway.
segments.tr: 수백만 미국인들은 어쨌든 더 비싼 것을 집어 든다.

segments.src: That decision, repeated at scale, *is* brand equity.
segments.tr: 대규모로 반복된 그 결정이 *바로* 브랜드 자산이다.

segments.src: People aren't buying better chemistry.
segments.tr: 사람들은 더 나은 화학을 사지 않는다.

segments.src: They're buying a reduction in doubt — at 2 a.m., with a sick kid, when you don't want to be the person who experimented.
segments.tr: 의심을 덜 수 있다는 안심감을 사는 것이다 — 오전 2시, 아픈 아이와 함께, 누군가 실험을 하고 싶지 않을 때.

segments.src: Some of that trust was earned in a specific moment.
segments.tr: 그 신뢰의 일부는 특정한 순간에 얻어졌다.

segments.src: In 1982, seven people in the Chicago area died after someone laced Tylenol capsules with cyanide.
segments.tr: 1982년, 누군가가 타이레놀 캡슐에 청화물을 섞은 후 시카고 지역에서 7명이 사망했다.

segments.src: Johnson & Johnson pulled roughly 31 million bottles nationwide, went public fast, and came back with tamper-evident packaging that became the industry norm.
segments.tr: Johnson & Johnson은 전국적으로 약 3,100만 병을 회수했고, 빠르게 공개했으며, 업계 표준이 된 변조 방지 포장으로 돌아왔다.

segments.src: The brand lost most of its share and rebuilt it within about a year.
segments.tr: 브랜드는 대부분의 점유율을 잃었고 약 1년 만에 재건했다.

segments.src: That's the double lesson: equity is fragile enough to nearly vanish in a week, and durable enough to be worth defending at enormous cost.
segments.tr: 이것이 이중의 교훈이다: 자산은 일주일 만에 거의 사라질 정도로 취약하고, 막대한 비용을 들일 가치가 있을 정도로 견고하다.

segments.src: Now look one shelf over at the extensions: Tylenol PM.
segments.tr: 이제 한 선반 옆의 확장 제품들을 보자: 타이레놀 PM.

segments.src: Tylenol Cold + Flu.
segments.tr: 타이레놀 감기+독감.

segments.src: Children's Tylenol.
segments.tr: 어린이용 타이레놀.

segments.src: Every one of them is the same bet — *you already trust us with your headache, so trust us with your cold.* High perceived fit, so the borrowing works.
segments.tr: 이들 각각은 같은 베팅이다 — *당신은 이미 우리를 두통에 믿고 있으니, 감기도 믿으세요.* 높은 지각된 적합도이므로 신뢰 활용이 작동한다.

segments.src: Then ask yourself the honest question: would you buy Tylenol-brand energy drinks?
segments.tr: 그러면 스스로에게 솔직한 질문을 던져보자: 타이레놀 브랜드 에너지 음료를 사겠는가?

segments.src: Same company, same trust, same shelf.
segments.tr: 같은 회사, 같은 신뢰, 같은 선반.

segments.src: But the fit collapses, and so would the extension.
segments.tr: 하지만 적합도가 무너지고, 확장도 그럴 것이다.

segments.src: Tylenol means "makes discomfort go away safely."
segments.tr: 타이레놀은 "불편함을 안전하게 없애준다"는 뜻이다.

segments.src: An energy drink means the opposite of sedation.
segments.tr: 에너지 음료는 진정의 정반대를 의미한다.

segments.src: The name would fight the product.
segments.tr: 이름이 제품과 싸울 것이다.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 3줄 요약

segments.src: 1. Brand equity is the value the name adds on top of the product — built from awareness, perceived quality, associations, and loyalty.
segments.tr: 1. 브랜드 자산은 이름이 제품 위에 더하는 가치다 — 인지도, 지각된 품질, 연관성, 충성도로 구축된다.

segments.src: 2. Brand identity is what you intend to mean; brand image is what customers actually think you mean, and the gap between them is the job.
segments.tr: 2. 브랜드 정체성은 당신이 의도한 의미고, 브랜드 이미지는 고객들이 실제로 당신이 의도한다고 생각하는 것이며, 그 둘의 차이를 줄이는 것이 바로 일이다.

segments.src: 3. Brand extensions let you spend accumulated equity in a new category — profitable when perceived fit is high, dilutive when it isn't.
segments.tr: 3. 브랜드 확장은 새로운 카테고리에서 누적된 자산을 사용하게 해준다 — 지각된 적합도가 높을 때 수익성이 있고, 낮을 때는 희석 효과가 있다.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 자가진단

segments.src: **1.** A store-brand acetaminophen has the identical active ingredient and dose as the national brand, yet many shoppers pay more for the national brand.
segments.tr: **1.** 가게 브랜드 아세트아미노펜은 국가 브랜드와 동일한 활성 성분과 용량을 가지고 있지만, 많은 쇼핑객들은 국가 브랜드에 더 많은 돈을 지불한다.

segments.src: This price premium is the clearest everyday evidence of:
segments.tr: 이 가격 프리미엄은 다음 중 무엇의 가장 명백한 일상적 증거인가?

segments.src: - A) Product differentiation through formulation
segments.tr: - A) 제형을 통한 제품 차별화

segments.src: - B) Brand equity
segments.tr: - B) 브랜드 자산

segments.src: - C) A distribution advantage
segments.tr: - C) 유통 이점

segments.src: - D) Regulatory protection
segments.tr: - D) 규제 보호

segments.src: **2.** True or False: Brand identity and brand image mean the same thing.
segments.tr: **2.** 참 또는 거짓: 브랜드 정체성과 브랜드 이미지는 같은 의미다.

segments.src: **3.** A premium coffee brand launches branded ceramic mugs and travel tumblers.
segments.tr: **3.** 프리미엄 커피 브랜드가 브랜드 도자기 머그와 여행용 텀블러를 출시한다.

segments.src: Compared with that same brand launching motor oil, the mug launch is more likely to succeed mainly because of:
segments.tr: 같은 브랜드가 모터 오일을 출시하는 것과 비교할 때, 머그 출시가 더 성공할 가능성이 높은 주된 이유는?

segments.src: - A) Lower manufacturing cost
segments.tr: - A) 낮은 제조 비용

segments.src: - B) Higher perceived fit with existing brand associations
segments.tr: - B) 기존 브랜드 연관성과 높은 지각된 적합도

segments.src: - C) Stronger patent position
segments.tr: - C) 더 강한 특허 위치

segments.src: - D) A larger addressable market
segments.tr: - D) 더 큰 잠재 시장

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Brand equity** — the added value a brand name gives a product beyond its functional attributes, visible as price premium, loyalty, and market power.
segments.tr: - **브랜드 자산** — 브랜드 이름이 제품의 기능적 특성 이상으로 더하는 추가 가치, 가격 프리미엄, 충성도, 시장 영향력으로 나타난다.

segments.src: - **Brand identity** — the meaning and personality the company deliberately builds and wants the brand to stand for.
segments.tr: - **브랜드 정체성** — 회사가 의도적으로 구축하고 브랜드가 나타내길 원하는 의미와 개성.

segments.src: - **Brand image** — the meaning customers actually hold in their heads, which may differ from the intended identity.
segments.tr: - **브랜드 이미지** — 고객들이 실제로 머리 속에 가지고 있는 의미, 의도한 정체성과 다를 수 있다.

segments.src: - **Brand extension** — launching a product in a *new* category under an existing brand name (versus a **line extension**, a new variant inside the same category).
segments.tr: - **브랜드 확장** — 기존 브랜드 이름으로 *새로운* 카테고리에서 제품을 출시하는 것(같은 카테고리 내 새로운 변형인 **라인 확장**과는 다름).

segments.src: - **Brand dilution** — the weakening of a brand's core associations, typically caused by extensions that don't fit or by inconsistent quality.
segments.tr: - **브랜드 희석** — 브랜드의 핵심 연관성이 약화되는 것, 보통 적합하지 않는 확장이나 일관성 없는 품질로 인해 발생한다.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** With the active ingredient, dose, and regulatory standard held constant, the leftover willingness to pay is attributable to the name itself; that's the price-premium view of brand equity.
segments.tr: *답: **1 — B.** 활성 성분, 용량, 규제 기준을 일정하게 유지하면, 남은 지불 의사는 이름 자체에 기인한다; 이것이 브랜드 자산의 가격 프리미엄 관점이다.

segments.src: **2 — False.** Identity is sender-side (what the firm intends); image is receiver-side (what the customer perceives).
segments.tr: **2 — 거짓.** 정체성은 발신자 측(회사가 의도한 것)이고, 이미지는 수신자 측(고객이 인지한 것)이다.

segments.src: Managing a brand largely means shrinking the distance between the two.
segments.tr: 브랜드를 관리한다는 것은 주로 이 둘 사이의 거리를 줄이는 것을 의미한다.

segments.src: **3 — B.** Mugs and tumblers sit naturally inside a coffee brand's existing associations, so consumers transfer trust easily.
segments.tr: **3 — B.** 머그와 텀블러는 커피 브랜드의 기존 연관성 속에 자연스럽게 앉아 있으므로, 소비자들은 신뢰를 쉽게 옮긴다.

segments.src: Motor oil shares no meaningful associations with coffee, so the transfer fails and risks diluting the parent brand.*
segments.tr: 모터 오일은 커피와 의미 있는 연관성을 공유하지 않으므로, 신뢰 전이가 실패하고 모브랜드를 희석시킬 위험이 있다.*

zh.title: [营销101 #11] 为什么加了一个名字的同一粒药丸要贵一倍

segments.src: > A brand is a promise stored in someone's head — and brand management is the work of building that promise, keeping it consistent, and knowing how far you can stretch it before it snaps.
segments.tr: > 品牌是储存在某人头脑中的承诺——品牌管理就是建立这个承诺、保持一致性，以及知道在它崩溃前你能把它延伸多远的工作。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日概念

segments.src: Walk into any store and you'll find two products that are physically close to identical, sitting side by side, with very different price tags.
segments.tr: 走进任何一家商店，你都会发现两种产品在物理上几乎完全相同，并排放在一起，但价格标签却差异很大。

segments.src: Nothing about the atoms explains the gap.
segments.tr: 原子的任何特性都解释不了这个价差。

segments.src: Something about the *name* does.
segments.tr: 但*名字*能解释。

segments.src: That gap has a name in marketing: **brand equity** — the extra value a brand name adds beyond what the product itself delivers.
segments.tr: 这个价差在营销中有一个名称：**品牌资产**——品牌名称在产品本身提供的价值之外所增加的额外价值。

segments.src: One rough way to picture it:
segments.tr: 粗略地看的一种方式：

segments.src: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version
segments.tr: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version

segments.src: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version
segments.tr: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version

segments.src: That's a simplification (equity also shows up as loyalty, bargaining power with retailers, and cheaper customer acquisition), but it makes the idea concrete: equity is measurable, and it lives in the customer's mind, not on the factory floor.
segments.tr: 这是一个简化（资产也体现为忠诚度、与零售商的议价权和更便宜的客户获取），但它使这个理念具体化：资产是可以衡量的，它存在于客户的头脑中，而不是工厂车间。

segments.src: Marketing academics usually break brand equity into four building blocks, following David Aaker's well-known model:
segments.tr: 市场营销学者通常根据David Aaker的著名模型将品牌资产分解为四个构建块：

segments.src: - **Awareness** — do people know you exist, and do you come to mind first?
segments.tr: - **认知度** ——人们知道你存在吗，你是否首先出现在他们的脑海中？

segments.src: - **Perceived quality** — do they believe you're good, whether or not lab tests agree?
segments.tr: - **感知质量** ——他们认为你很好吗，无论实验室测试是否同意？

segments.src: - **Associations** — what images, feelings, and situations attach to the name?
segments.tr: - **联想** ——什么图像、感受和情形与这个名字相关联？

segments.src: - **Loyalty** — will they buy you again when a cheaper option is right there?
segments.tr: - **忠诚度** ——当更便宜的选择就在那里时，他们会再次购买你吗？

segments.src: Now, the second concept.
segments.tr: 现在，第二个概念。

segments.src: **Brand identity** is what the company *intends* the brand to stand for — the positioning, the personality, the visual system, the tone.
segments.tr: **品牌认同**是公司*意图*让品牌代表什么——定位、个性、视觉系统、语调。

segments.src: **Brand image** is what customers *actually* believe.
segments.tr: **品牌形象**是客户*实际上*相信的。

segments.src: Those two are rarely the same thing, and closing the gap is most of a brand manager's job.
segments.tr: 这两者很少相同，缩小差距是品牌经理工作的大部分。

segments.src: You control the identity.
segments.tr: 你控制认同。

segments.src: You only influence the image.
segments.tr: 你只能影响形象。

segments.src: Third: **brand extension**.
segments.tr: 第三：**品牌延伸**。

segments.src: Once a brand has equity, it's tempting to spend it — to launch a product in a new category under the same name and borrow the trust you've already earned.
segments.tr: 一旦品牌有了资产，就很容易去花费它——在相同名字下推出一个新类别的产品，并借用你已经获得的信任。

segments.src: Extensions are cheap compared to building a brand from zero, and that's exactly why they're overused.
segments.tr: 与从零开始建立品牌相比，延伸很便宜，这正是它们被过度使用的原因。

segments.src: The variable that predicts success is **perceived fit**: does the new product feel like something this brand would plausibly make?
segments.tr: 预测成功的变量是**感知适配度**：新产品感觉起来像这个品牌可能会制造的东西吗？

segments.src: Nike moving from shoes into athletic apparel fits.
segments.tr: Nike从鞋类进入运动服装是合适的。

segments.src: Apple moving from computers into phones fits.
segments.tr: Apple从计算机进入手机是合适的。

segments.src: Harley-Davidson launching a perfume in the 1990s did not fit, and it's still cited in textbooks as the cautionary tale.
segments.tr: 哈雷-戴维森在1990年代推出香水不合适，它仍然在教科书中被引用为警示故事。

segments.src: When fit is weak, the extension usually fails — and worse, it can cause **brand dilution**, muddying the associations that made the parent brand valuable in the first place.
segments.tr: 当适配度较弱时，延伸通常会失败——更糟的是，它会导致**品牌稀释**，混淆使母品牌在首次获得价值的联想。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 在日常生活中

segments.src: Stand in the pain-relief aisle at a CVS or a Walgreens.
segments.tr: 站在CVS或Walgreens的止痛药通道中。

segments.src: On the shelf: Tylenol Extra Strength, 500 mg acetaminophen.
segments.tr: 架子上：泰诺(Tylenol)加强型，500毫克对乙酰氨基酚。

segments.src: Next to it: the store's own brand — CVS Health or Walgreens — also 500 mg acetaminophen.
segments.tr: 旁边是：该商店自有品牌——CVS Health或Walgreens——也是500毫克对乙酰氨基酚。

segments.src: Same active ingredient, same dose, both regulated by the FDA to the same standard.
segments.tr: 相同的有效成分，相同的剂量，都由FDA按相同标准监管。

segments.src: The store brand often costs noticeably less per caplet; the exact spread moves with sales and store, but a several-dollar gap on a 100-count bottle is typical.
segments.tr: 商店品牌通常每粒成本明显更低；具体差价随销售和商店而变化，但100粒瓶装的几美元差距是典型的。

segments.src: Millions of Americans reach for the more expensive one anyway.
segments.tr: 数百万美国人仍然会选择更昂贵的一种。

segments.src: That decision, repeated at scale, *is* brand equity.
segments.tr: 这个决定，大规模重复，*就是*品牌资产。

segments.src: People aren't buying better chemistry.
segments.tr: 人们不是在购买更好的化学成分。

segments.src: They're buying a reduction in doubt — at 2 a.m., with a sick kid, when you don't want to be the person who experimented.
segments.tr: 他们在购买疑虑的减少——凌晨2点，孩子生病了，当你不想成为那个尝试的人时。

segments.src: Some of that trust was earned in a specific moment.
segments.tr: 部分信任是在特定时刻获得的。

segments.src: In 1982, seven people in the Chicago area died after someone laced Tylenol capsules with cyanide.
segments.tr: 1982年，芝加哥地区有七人因为有人在泰诺胶囊中掺入氰化物而死亡。

segments.src: Johnson & Johnson pulled roughly 31 million bottles nationwide, went public fast, and came back with tamper-evident packaging that became the industry norm.
segments.tr: 强生公司在全国范围内撤出了大约31百万瓶，快速公开，并以防篡改包装卷土重来，这成为了行业规范。

segments.src: The brand lost most of its share and rebuilt it within about a year.
segments.tr: 该品牌失去了大部分市场份额，并在大约一年内重建了它。

segments.src: That's the double lesson: equity is fragile enough to nearly vanish in a week, and durable enough to be worth defending at enormous cost.
segments.tr: 这是双重教训：资产脆弱到足以在一周内几乎消失，而且耐用到值得以巨大代价进行防守。

segments.src: Now look one shelf over at the extensions: Tylenol PM.
segments.tr: 现在看看隔壁架子上的延伸产品：泰诺(Tylenol) PM。

segments.src: Tylenol Cold + Flu.
segments.tr: 泰诺(Tylenol)感冒+流感。

segments.src: Children's Tylenol.
segments.tr: 儿童泰诺(Tylenol)。

segments.src: Every one of them is the same bet — *you already trust us with your headache, so trust us with your cold.* High perceived fit, so the borrowing works.
segments.tr: 每一个都是相同的赌注——*你已经相信我们能处理你的头痛，所以也相信我们能处理你的感冒。*高感知适配度，所以借用有效。

segments.src: Then ask yourself the honest question: would you buy Tylenol-brand energy drinks?
segments.tr: 然后问自己一个诚实的问题：你会购买泰诺(Tylenol)品牌的能量饮料吗？

segments.src: Same company, same trust, same shelf.
segments.tr: 相同的公司，相同的信任，相同的架子。

segments.src: But the fit collapses, and so would the extension.
segments.tr: 但适配度崩溃了，延伸产品也会失败。

segments.src: Tylenol means "makes discomfort go away safely."
segments.tr: 泰诺(Tylenol)意味着"安全地消除不适"。

segments.src: An energy drink means the opposite of sedation.
segments.tr: 能量饮料意味着与镇静相反的东西。

segments.src: The name would fight the product.
segments.tr: 这个名字会与产品相冲突。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 三行总结

segments.src: 1. Brand equity is the value the name adds on top of the product — built from awareness, perceived quality, associations, and loyalty.
segments.tr: 1. 品牌资产是名称在产品基础上增加的价值——由认知度、感知质量、联想和忠诚度构建。

segments.src: 2. Brand identity is what you intend to mean; brand image is what customers actually think you mean, and the gap between them is the job.
segments.tr: 2. 品牌认同是你的意图意思；品牌形象是客户实际上认为你的意思，两者之间的差距是工作。

segments.src: 3. Brand extensions let you spend accumulated equity in a new category — profitable when perceived fit is high, dilutive when it isn't.
segments.tr: 3. 品牌延伸让你在新类别中花费累积的资产——当感知适配度高时盈利，当适配度不高时会稀释。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 自测问卷

segments.src: **1.** A store-brand acetaminophen has the identical active ingredient and dose as the national brand, yet many shoppers pay more for the national brand.
segments.tr: **1.** 商店品牌的对乙酰氨基酚具有与国家品牌相同的有效成分和剂量，但许多购物者为国家品牌支付更多费用。

segments.src: This price premium is the clearest everyday evidence of:
segments.tr: 这个价格溢价是最清晰的日常证据，证明了：

segments.src: - A) Product differentiation through formulation
segments.tr: - A) 通过配方进行产品差异化

segments.src: - B) Brand equity
segments.tr: - B) 品牌资产

segments.src: - C) A distribution advantage
segments.tr: - C) 分销优势

segments.src: - D) Regulatory protection
segments.tr: - D) 监管保护

segments.src: **2.** True or False: Brand identity and brand image mean the same thing.
segments.tr: **2.** 真假题：品牌认同和品牌形象意思相同。

segments.src: **3.** A premium coffee brand launches branded ceramic mugs and travel tumblers.
segments.tr: **3.** 一个高端咖啡品牌推出品牌陶瓷杯和旅行杯。

segments.src: Compared with that same brand launching motor oil, the mug launch is more likely to succeed mainly because of:
segments.tr: 与相同品牌推出机油相比，杯子推出更可能成功的主要原因是：

segments.src: - A) Lower manufacturing cost
segments.tr: - A) 更低的制造成本

segments.src: - B) Higher perceived fit with existing brand associations
segments.tr: - B) 与现有品牌联想的更高感知适配度

segments.src: - C) Stronger patent position
segments.tr: - C) 更强的专利地位

segments.src: - D) A larger addressable market
segments.tr: - D) 更大的可寻址市场

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日术语

segments.src: - **Brand equity** — the added value a brand name gives a product beyond its functional attributes, visible as price premium, loyalty, and market power.
segments.tr: - **品牌资产** ——品牌名称给产品带来的超越其功能属性的增加值，表现为价格溢价、忠诚度和市场力量。

segments.src: - **Brand identity** — the meaning and personality the company deliberately builds and wants the brand to stand for.
segments.tr: - **品牌认同** ——公司有意建立并希望品牌代表的意义和个性。

segments.src: - **Brand image** — the meaning customers actually hold in their heads, which may differ from the intended identity.
segments.tr: - **品牌形象** ——客户在他们脑海中实际持有的意义，可能与预期的认同不同。

segments.src: - **Brand extension** — launching a product in a *new* category under an existing brand name (versus a **line extension**, a new variant inside the same category).
segments.tr: - **品牌延伸** ——在现有品牌名称下在*新*类别中推出产品（与**线延伸**相对，线延伸是同一类别内的新变体）。

segments.src: - **Brand dilution** — the weakening of a brand's core associations, typically caused by extensions that don't fit or by inconsistent quality.
segments.tr: - **品牌稀释** ——品牌核心联想的削弱，通常由不合适的延伸或不一致的质量引起。

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** With the active ingredient, dose, and regulatory standard held constant, the leftover willingness to pay is attributable to the name itself; that's the price-premium view of brand equity.
segments.tr: *答案：**1 — B.** 当有效成分、剂量和监管标准保持不变时，剩余的支付意愿应归因于名字本身；这是品牌资产的价格溢价视角。

segments.src: **2 — False.** Identity is sender-side (what the firm intends); image is receiver-side (what the customer perceives).
segments.tr: **2 — 错误。** 认同是发送方（公司的意图）；形象是接收方（客户的感知）。

segments.src: Managing a brand largely means shrinking the distance between the two.
segments.tr: 管理一个品牌在很大程度上意味着缩小这两者之间的距离。

segments.src: **3 — B.** Mugs and tumblers sit naturally inside a coffee brand's existing associations, so consumers transfer trust easily.
segments.tr: **3 — B.** 杯子和旅行杯自然地位于咖啡品牌的现有联想内，所以消费者很容易转移信任。

segments.src: Motor oil shares no meaningful associations with coffee, so the transfer fails and risks diluting the parent brand.*
segments.tr: 机油与咖啡没有有意义的联想，所以转移失败，有稀释母品牌的风险。*

hi.title: [मार्केटिंग 101 #11] समान गोली ब्रांड नाम के साथ दोगुनी कीमत पर क्यों बिकती है

segments.src: > A brand is a promise stored in someone's head — and brand management is the work of building that promise, keeping it consistent, and knowing how far you can stretch it before it snaps.
segments.tr: > एक ब्रांड किसी के दिमाग में संग्रहीत एक वादा है — और ब्रांड प्रबंधन उस वादे को बनाने, इसे सुसंगत रखने और यह जानने का काम है कि आप इसे तोड़ने से पहले कितनी दूर खींच सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## आज की अवधारणा

segments.src: Walk into any store and you'll find two products that are physically close to identical, sitting side by side, with very different price tags.
segments.tr: किसी भी दुकान में जाएं और आप दो उत्पाद पाएंगे जो भौतिक रूप से लगभग समान हैं, एक दूसरे के बगल में बैठे हैं, बिल्कुल अलग कीमत टैग के साथ।

segments.src: Nothing about the atoms explains the gap.
segments.tr: परमाणुओं के बारे में कुछ भी इस अंतर को समझाता नहीं है।

segments.src: Something about the *name* does.
segments.tr: *नाम* के बारे में कुछ करता है।

segments.src: That gap has a name in marketing: **brand equity** — the extra value a brand name adds beyond what the product itself delivers.
segments.tr: विपणन में इस अंतर का एक नाम है: **ब्रांड इक्विटी** — वह अतिरिक्त मूल्य जो एक ब्रांड नाम उस से अधिक जोड़ता है जो उत्पाद ही प्रदान करता है।

segments.src: One rough way to picture it:
segments.tr: इसे दिखाने का एक मोटा तरीका है:

segments.src: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version
segments.tr: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version

segments.src: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version
segments.tr: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version

segments.src: That's a simplification (equity also shows up as loyalty, bargaining power with retailers, and cheaper customer acquisition), but it makes the idea concrete: equity is measurable, and it lives in the customer's mind, not on the factory floor.
segments.tr: यह एक सरलीकरण है (इक्विटी आनुगत्य, खुदरा विक्रेताओं के साथ सौदेबाजी की शक्ति, और सस्ते ग्राहक अधिग्रहण के रूप में भी प्रकट होती है), लेकिन यह विचार को ठोस बनाता है: इक्विटी मापने योग्य है, और यह ग्राहक के दिमाग में रहती है, फैक्टरी के फर्श पर नहीं।

segments.src: Marketing academics usually break brand equity into four building blocks, following David Aaker's well-known model:
segments.tr: विपणन विद्वान आमतौर पर डेविड एकर के प्रसिद्ध मॉडल का पालन करते हुए ब्रांड इक्विटी को चार मूल घटकों में विभाजित करते हैं:

segments.src: - **Awareness** — do people know you exist, and do you come to mind first?
segments.tr: - **जागरूकता** — क्या लोग जानते हैं कि आप मौजूद हैं, और क्या आप पहले दिमाग में आते हैं?

segments.src: - **Perceived quality** — do they believe you're good, whether or not lab tests agree?
segments.tr: - **माना गया गुणवत्ता** — क्या वे मानते हैं कि आप अच्छे हैं, भले ही प्रयोगशाला परीक्षण सहमत हों या न हों?

segments.src: - **Associations** — what images, feelings, and situations attach to the name?
segments.tr: - **संबद्धताएं** — कौन सी छवियां, भावनाएं और स्थितियां नाम से जुड़ी हुई हैं?

segments.src: - **Loyalty** — will they buy you again when a cheaper option is right there?
segments.tr: - **आनुगत्य** — क्या वे जब सस्ता विकल्प सही वहां है तो आपको फिर से खरीदेंगे?

segments.src: Now, the second concept.
segments.tr: अब, दूसरी अवधारणा।

segments.src: **Brand identity** is what the company *intends* the brand to stand for — the positioning, the personality, the visual system, the tone.
segments.tr: **ब्रांड पहचान** यह है कि कंपनी *इरादा करती है* ब्रांड को किसके लिए खड़ा होना है — स्थिति, व्यक्तित्व, दृश्य प्रणाली, टोन।

segments.src: **Brand image** is what customers *actually* believe.
segments.tr: **ब्रांड इमेज** यह है कि ग्राहक *वास्तव में* विश्वास करते हैं।

segments.src: Those two are rarely the same thing, and closing the gap is most of a brand manager's job.
segments.tr: वे दोनों शायद ही कभी एक ही चीज़ होते हैं, और अंतर को बंद करना एक ब्रांड मैनेजर के काम का अधिकांश है।

segments.src: You control the identity.
segments.tr: आप पहचान को नियंत्रित करते हैं।

segments.src: You only influence the image.
segments.tr: आप केवल छवि को प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.src: Third: **brand extension**.
segments.tr: तीसरा: **ब्रांड विस्तार**।

segments.src: Once a brand has equity, it's tempting to spend it — to launch a product in a new category under the same name and borrow the trust you've already earned.
segments.tr: एक बार जब किसी ब्रांड के पास इक्विटी होती है, तो इसे खर्च करना लुभावना होता है — एक नई श्रेणी में एक ही नाम के तहत एक उत्पाद लॉन्च करने और आपके द्वारा पहले से अर्जित विश्वास का उपयोग करने के लिए।

segments.src: Extensions are cheap compared to building a brand from zero, and that's exactly why they're overused.
segments.tr: शून्य से एक ब्रांड बनाने की तुलना में विस्तार सस्ते होते हैं, और यही कारण है कि वे अत्यधिक उपयोग किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: The variable that predicts success is **perceived fit**: does the new product feel like something this brand would plausibly make?
segments.tr: सफलता की भविष्यवाणी करने वाला चर है **माना गया फिट**: क्या नया उत्पाद ऐसा लगता है कि यह ब्रांड प्रशंसनीय रूप से बना सकता है?

segments.src: Nike moving from shoes into athletic apparel fits.
segments.tr: नाइके का जूते से एथलेटिक परिधान में जाना फिट बैठता है।

segments.src: Apple moving from computers into phones fits.
segments.tr: एप्पल का कंप्यूटर से फोन में जाना फिट बैठता है।

segments.src: Harley-Davidson launching a perfume in the 1990s did not fit, and it's still cited in textbooks as the cautionary tale.
segments.tr: हार्ले-डेविडसन का 1990 के दशक में परफ्यूम लॉन्च करना फिट नहीं बैठा, और इसे अभी भी पाठ्यपुस्तकों में सावधानी की कहानी के रूप में उद्धृत किया जाता है।

segments.src: When fit is weak, the extension usually fails — and worse, it can cause **brand dilution**, muddying the associations that made the parent brand valuable in the first place.
segments.tr: जब फिट कमजोर होता है, तो विस्तार आमतौर पर विफल हो जाता है — और बदतर, यह **ब्रांड कमजोरी** का कारण बन सकता है, उन संबद्धताओं को धुंधला कर सकता है जो पहली जगह में पैरेंट ब्रांड को मूल्यवान बनाती हैं।

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी में

segments.src: Stand in the pain-relief aisle at a CVS or a Walgreens.
segments.tr: सीवीएस या वालग्रीन्स में दर्द निवारण गलियारे में खड़े हो जाएं।

segments.src: On the shelf: Tylenol Extra Strength, 500 mg acetaminophen.
segments.tr: शेल्फ पर: टायलेनॉल एक्स्ट्रा स्ट्रेंथ, 500 मिलीग्राम एसिटामिनोफेन।

segments.src: Next to it: the store's own brand — CVS Health or Walgreens — also 500 mg acetaminophen.
segments.tr: इसके बगल में: स्टोर का अपना ब्रांड — सीवीएस हेल्थ या वालग्रीन्स — भी 500 मिलीग्राम एसिटामिनोफेन।

segments.src: Same active ingredient, same dose, both regulated by the FDA to the same standard.
segments.tr: समान सक्रिय घटक, समान खुराक, दोनों एफडीए द्वारा समान मानक के लिए विनियमित।

segments.src: The store brand often costs noticeably less per caplet; the exact spread moves with sales and store, but a several-dollar gap on a 100-count bottle is typical.
segments.tr: स्टोर ब्रांड अक्सर प्रति कैप्लेट में कम खर्च करता है; सटीक अंतर बिक्री और स्टोर के साथ चलता है, लेकिन 100-गिनती की बोतल पर कई डॉलर का अंतर विशिष्ट है।

segments.src: Millions of Americans reach for the more expensive one anyway.
segments.tr: लाखों अमेरिकी वैसे भी अधिक महंगे विकल्प के लिए पहुंचते हैं।

segments.src: That decision, repeated at scale, *is* brand equity.
segments.tr: वह निर्णय, पैमाने पर दोहराया गया, *है* ब्रांड इक्विटी।

segments.src: People aren't buying better chemistry.
segments.tr: लोग बेहतर रसायन विज्ञान नहीं खरीद रहे हैं।

segments.src: They're buying a reduction in doubt — at 2 a.m., with a sick kid, when you don't want to be the person who experimented.
segments.tr: वे संदेह में कमी खरीद रहे हैं — सुबह 2 बजे, एक बीमार बच्चे के साथ, जब आप उस व्यक्ति नहीं बनना चाहते जो प्रयोग करे।

segments.src: Some of that trust was earned in a specific moment.
segments.tr: उस विश्वास का कुछ हिस्सा एक विशिष्ट क्षण में अर्जित किया गया था।

segments.src: In 1982, seven people in the Chicago area died after someone laced Tylenol capsules with cyanide.
segments.tr: 1982 में, शिकागो क्षेत्र में सात लोग मारे गए जब किसी ने टायलेनॉल कैप्सूल में साइनाइड मिलाया।

segments.src: Johnson & Johnson pulled roughly 31 million bottles nationwide, went public fast, and came back with tamper-evident packaging that became the industry norm.
segments.tr: जॉनसन एंड जॉनसन ने देश भर में लगभग 31 मिलियन बोतलें खींचीं, जल्दी सार्वजनिक हुए, और छेड़छाड़-स्पष्ट पैकेजिंग के साथ वापस आए जो उद्योग मानदंड बन गया।

segments.src: The brand lost most of its share and rebuilt it within about a year.
segments.tr: ब्रांड ने अपना अधिकांश हिस्सा खो दिया और लगभग एक साल के भीतर इसे फिर से बनाया।

segments.src: That's the double lesson: equity is fragile enough to nearly vanish in a week, and durable enough to be worth defending at enormous cost.
segments.tr: यह दोहरी सबक है: इक्विटी एक हफ्ते में लगभग गायब हो जाने के लिए काफी नाजुक है, और भारी लागत पर बचाव के लायक होने के लिए टिकाऊ है।

segments.src: Now look one shelf over at the extensions: Tylenol PM.
segments.tr: अब विस्तार पर एक शेल्फ देखें: टायलेनॉल पीएम।

segments.src: Tylenol Cold + Flu.
segments.tr: टायलेनॉल कोल्ड + फ्लू।

segments.src: Children's Tylenol.
segments.tr: बच्चों का टायलेनॉल।

segments.src: Every one of them is the same bet — *you already trust us with your headache, so trust us with your cold.* High perceived fit, so the borrowing works.
segments.tr: इनमें से हर एक वही दांव है — *आप पहले से ही अपने सिरदर्द के साथ हमें विश्वास करते हैं, इसलिए अपनी सर्दी के साथ हमें विश्वास करें।* उच्च माना गया फिट, तो उधार काम करता है।

segments.src: Then ask yourself the honest question: would you buy Tylenol-brand energy drinks?
segments.tr: फिर अपने आप से ईमानदार सवाल पूछें: क्या आप टायलेनॉल-ब्रांड ऊर्जा पेय खरीदेंगे?

segments.src: Same company, same trust, same shelf.
segments.tr: एक ही कंपनी, एक ही विश्वास, एक ही शेल्फ।

segments.src: But the fit collapses, and so would the extension.
segments.tr: लेकिन फिट ढह जाता है, और विस्तार भी ढह जाता है।

segments.src: Tylenol means "makes discomfort go away safely."
segments.tr: टायलेनॉल का मतलब है "आराम को सुरक्षित रूप से दूर करता है।"

segments.src: An energy drink means the opposite of sedation.
segments.tr: एक ऊर्जा पेय का मतलब शामक के विपरीत है।

segments.src: The name would fight the product.
segments.tr: नाम उत्पाद से लड़ता है।

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## तीन-पंक्ति पुनरावलोकन

segments.src: 1. Brand equity is the value the name adds on top of the product — built from awareness, perceived quality, associations, and loyalty.
segments.tr: 1. ब्रांड इक्विटी उत्पाद के शीर्ष पर नाम जोड़ने वाला मूल्य है — जागरूकता, माना गया गुणवत्ता, संबद्धताओं और आनुगत्य से निर्मित।

segments.src: 2. Brand identity is what you intend to mean; brand image is what customers actually think you mean, and the gap between them is the job.
segments.tr: 2. ब्रांड पहचान यह है कि आप क्या मतलब रखते हैं; ब्रांड इमेज यह है कि ग्राहक वास्तव में आप क्या मतलब रखते हैं सोचते हैं, और उनके बीच का अंतर काम है।

segments.src: 3. Brand extensions let you spend accumulated equity in a new category — profitable when perceived fit is high, dilutive when it isn't.
segments.tr: 3. ब्रांड विस्तार आपको एक नई श्रेणी में संचित इक्विटी खर्च करने देते हैं — लाभदायक जब माना गया फिट अधिक है, कमजोर करने वाला जब नहीं है।

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ स्व-प्रश्नोत्तरी

segments.src: **1.** A store-brand acetaminophen has the identical active ingredient and dose as the national brand, yet many shoppers pay more for the national brand.
segments.tr: **1.** एक स्टोर-ब्रांड एसिटामिनोफेन में राष्ट्रीय ब्रांड के समान सक्रिय घटक और खुराक है, फिर भी कई खरीदार राष्ट्रीय ब्रांड के लिए अधिक भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: This price premium is the clearest everyday evidence of:
segments.tr: यह कीमत प्रीमियम स्पष्ट रोज़मर्रा का सबूत है:

segments.src: - A) Product differentiation through formulation
segments.tr: - ए) सूत्रीकरण के माध्यम से उत्पाद भेदभाव

segments.src: - B) Brand equity
segments.tr: - बी) ब्रांड इक्विटी

segments.src: - C) A distribution advantage
segments.tr: - सी) एक वितरण लाभ

segments.src: - D) Regulatory protection
segments.tr: - डी) नियामक सुरक्षा

segments.src: **2.** True or False: Brand identity and brand image mean the same thing.
segments.tr: **2.** सत्य या असत्य: ब्रांड पहचान और ब्रांड इमेज का एक ही अर्थ है।

segments.src: **3.** A premium coffee brand launches branded ceramic mugs and travel tumblers.
segments.tr: **3.** एक प्रीमियम कॉफी ब्रांड ब्रांडेड सिरेमिक मग और यात्रा टंबलर लॉन्च करता है।

segments.src: Compared with that same brand launching motor oil, the mug launch is more likely to succeed mainly because of:
segments.tr: इसी ब्रांड द्वारा मोटर तेल लॉन्च करने की तुलना में, मग लॉन्च मुख्य रूप से के कारण सफल होने की अधिक संभावना है:

segments.src: - A) Lower manufacturing cost
segments.tr: - ए) कम विनिर्माण लागत

segments.src: - B) Higher perceived fit with existing brand associations
segments.tr: - बी) मौजूदा ब्रांड संबद्धताओं के साथ उच्च माना गया फिट

segments.src: - C) Stronger patent position
segments.tr: - सी) मजबूत पेटेंट स्थिति

segments.src: - D) A larger addressable market
segments.tr: - डी) एक बड़ा संबोधन योग्य बाजार

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 आज की शर्तें

segments.src: - **Brand equity** — the added value a brand name gives a product beyond its functional attributes, visible as price premium, loyalty, and market power.
segments.tr: - **ब्रांड इक्विटी** — वह अतिरिक्त मूल्य जो एक ब्रांड नाम एक उत्पाद को इसके कार्यात्मक विशेषताओं से परे देता है, कीमत प्रीमियम, आनुगत्य और बाजार शक्ति के रूप में दिखाई देता है।

segments.src: - **Brand identity** — the meaning and personality the company deliberately builds and wants the brand to stand for.
segments.tr: - **ब्रांड पहचान** — वह अर्थ और व्यक्तित्व जो कंपनी जानबूझकर बनाती है और चाहती है कि ब्रांड के लिए खड़ा हो।

segments.src: - **Brand image** — the meaning customers actually hold in their heads, which may differ from the intended identity.
segments.tr: - **ब्रांड इमेज** — वह अर्थ जो ग्राहकों के पास वास्तव में है, जो इच्छित पहचान से अलग हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Brand extension** — launching a product in a *new* category under an existing brand name (versus a **line extension**, a new variant inside the same category).
segments.tr: - **ब्रांड विस्तार** — एक *नई* श्रेणी में एक मौजूदा ब्रांड नाम के तहत एक उत्पाद लॉन्च करना (एक **लाइन विस्तार** के विपरीत, एक नई श्रेणी के अंदर एक नई विविधता)।

segments.src: - **Brand dilution** — the weakening of a brand's core associations, typically caused by extensions that don't fit or by inconsistent quality.
segments.tr: - **ब्रांड कमजोरी** — एक ब्रांड की मूल संबद्धताओं का कमजोर होना, आमतौर पर ऐसे विस्तार के कारण जो फिट नहीं होते हैं या असंगत गुणवत्ता द्वारा।

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** With the active ingredient, dose, and regulatory standard held constant, the leftover willingness to pay is attributable to the name itself; that's the price-premium view of brand equity.
segments.tr: *उत्तर: **1 — बी।** सक्रिय घटक, खुराक और नियामक मानक को स्थिर रखते हुए, भुगतान करने की बची हुई इच्छा नाम के लिए जिम्मेदार है; यह ब्रांड इक्विटी का मूल्य-प्रीमियम दृष्टिकोण है।

segments.src: **2 — False.** Identity is sender-side (what the firm intends); image is receiver-side (what the customer perceives).
segments.tr: **2 — गलत।** पहचान प्रेषक-पक्ष है (फर्म क्या इरादा करती है); इमेज प्राप्तकर्ता-पक्ष है (ग्राहक क्या समझते हैं)।

segments.src: Managing a brand largely means shrinking the distance between the two.
segments.tr: एक ब्रांड का प्रबंधन काफी हद तक दोनों के बीच की दूरी को कम करने का मतलब है।

segments.src: **3 — B.** Mugs and tumblers sit naturally inside a coffee brand's existing associations, so consumers transfer trust easily.
segments.tr: **3 — बी।** मग और टंबलर एक कॉफी ब्रांड की मौजूदा संबद्धताओं के अंदर स्वाभाविक रूप से बैठते हैं, इसलिए ग्राहक आसानी से विश्वास स्थानांतरित करते हैं।

segments.src: Motor oil shares no meaningful associations with coffee, so the transfer fails and risks diluting the parent brand.*
segments.tr: मोटर तेल कॉफी के साथ कोई अर्थपूर्ण संबद्धता साझा नहीं करता, इसलिए स्थानांतरण विफल हो जाता है और पैरेंट ब्रांड को कमजोर करने का जोखिम है।*

es.title: [Marketing 101 #11] Por Qué la Misma Píldora Cuesta el Doble Solo por Tener un Nombre

segments.src: > A brand is a promise stored in someone's head — and brand management is the work of building that promise, keeping it consistent, and knowing how far you can stretch it before it snaps.
segments.tr: > Una marca es una promesa almacenada en la mente de alguien — y la gestión de marca es el trabajo de construir esa promesa, mantenerla consistente y saber hasta dónde puedes estirarla antes de que se rompa.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## El Concepto de Hoy

segments.src: Walk into any store and you'll find two products that are physically close to identical, sitting side by side, with very different price tags.
segments.tr: Entra a cualquier tienda y encontrarás dos productos que son prácticamente idénticos, colocados uno al lado del otro, con precios muy diferentes.

segments.src: Nothing about the atoms explains the gap.
segments.tr: Nada en los átomos explica la diferencia.

segments.src: Something about the *name* does.
segments.tr: Algo sobre el *nombre* sí la explica.

segments.src: That gap has a name in marketing: **brand equity** — the extra value a brand name adds beyond what the product itself delivers.
segments.tr: Esa diferencia tiene un nombre en marketing: **patrimonio de marca** — el valor extra que un nombre de marca añade más allá de lo que el producto en sí ofrece.

segments.src: One rough way to picture it:
segments.tr: Una forma aproximada de visualizarlo:

segments.src: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version
segments.tr: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version

segments.src: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version
segments.tr: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version

segments.src: That's a simplification (equity also shows up as loyalty, bargaining power with retailers, and cheaper customer acquisition), but it makes the idea concrete: equity is measurable, and it lives in the customer's mind, not on the factory floor.
segments.tr: Esto es una simplificación (el patrimonio también se manifiesta como lealtad, poder de negociación con minoristas y adquisición más económica de clientes), pero hace la idea concreta: el patrimonio es mensurable y vive en la mente del cliente, no en la planta de producción.

segments.src: Marketing academics usually break brand equity into four building blocks, following David Aaker's well-known model:
segments.tr: Los académicos de marketing generalmente dividen el patrimonio de marca en cuatro bloques de construcción, siguiendo el conocido modelo de David Aaker:

segments.src: - **Awareness** — do people know you exist, and do you come to mind first?
segments.tr: - **Conocimiento** — ¿la gente sabe que existes y vienes a la mente primero?

segments.src: - **Perceived quality** — do they believe you're good, whether or not lab tests agree?
segments.tr: - **Calidad percibida** — ¿creen que eres bueno, independientemente de lo que digan las pruebas de laboratorio?

segments.src: - **Associations** — what images, feelings, and situations attach to the name?
segments.tr: - **Asociaciones** — ¿qué imágenes, sentimientos y situaciones se vinculan con el nombre?

segments.src: - **Loyalty** — will they buy you again when a cheaper option is right there?
segments.tr: - **Lealtad** — ¿te comprarán de nuevo cuando hay una opción más barata justo al lado?

segments.src: Now, the second concept.
segments.tr: Ahora, el segundo concepto.

segments.src: **Brand identity** is what the company *intends* the brand to stand for — the positioning, the personality, the visual system, the tone.
segments.tr: **Identidad de marca** es lo que la empresa *intenta* que la marca represente — el posicionamiento, la personalidad, el sistema visual, el tono.

segments.src: **Brand image** is what customers *actually* believe.
segments.tr: **Imagen de marca** es lo que los clientes *realmente* creen.

segments.src: Those two are rarely the same thing, and closing the gap is most of a brand manager's job.
segments.tr: Esos dos rara vez son lo mismo, y cerrar la brecha es la mayor parte del trabajo de un gestor de marca.

segments.src: You control the identity.
segments.tr: Controlas la identidad.

segments.src: You only influence the image.
segments.tr: Solo influyes en la imagen.

segments.src: Third: **brand extension**.
segments.tr: Tercero: **extensión de marca**.

segments.src: Once a brand has equity, it's tempting to spend it — to launch a product in a new category under the same name and borrow the trust you've already earned.
segments.tr: Una vez que una marca tiene patrimonio, es tentador gastarlo — lanzar un producto en una nueva categoría bajo el mismo nombre y tomar prestada la confianza que ya has ganado.

segments.src: Extensions are cheap compared to building a brand from zero, and that's exactly why they're overused.
segments.tr: Las extensiones son baratas en comparación con construir una marca desde cero, y exactamente por eso se sobreusan.

segments.src: The variable that predicts success is **perceived fit**: does the new product feel like something this brand would plausibly make?
segments.tr: La variable que predice el éxito es **ajuste percibido**: ¿el nuevo producto se siente como algo que esta marca plausiblemente haría?

segments.src: Nike moving from shoes into athletic apparel fits.
segments.tr: Nike moviéndose de zapatos a ropa deportiva se ajusta.

segments.src: Apple moving from computers into phones fits.
segments.tr: Apple moviéndose de computadoras a teléfonos se ajusta.

segments.src: Harley-Davidson launching a perfume in the 1990s did not fit, and it's still cited in textbooks as the cautionary tale.
segments.tr: Harley-Davidson lanzando un perfume en los años 90 no se ajustaba, y todavía se cita en libros de texto como la historia de advertencia.

segments.src: When fit is weak, the extension usually fails — and worse, it can cause **brand dilution**, muddying the associations that made the parent brand valuable in the first place.
segments.tr: Cuando el ajuste es débil, la extensión generalmente falla — y peor aún, puede causar **dilución de marca**, oscureciendo las asociaciones que hicieron valiosa la marca original.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## En la Vida Cotidiana

segments.src: Stand in the pain-relief aisle at a CVS or a Walgreens.
segments.tr: Párate en el pasillo de alivio del dolor en una CVS o Walgreens.

segments.src: On the shelf: Tylenol Extra Strength, 500 mg acetaminophen.
segments.tr: En el estante: Tylenol Extra Strength, 500 mg acetaminofén.

segments.src: Next to it: the store's own brand — CVS Health or Walgreens — also 500 mg acetaminophen.
segments.tr: A su lado: la marca propia de la tienda — CVS Health o Walgreens — también 500 mg acetaminofén.

segments.src: Same active ingredient, same dose, both regulated by the FDA to the same standard.
segments.tr: El mismo ingrediente activo, la misma dosis, ambas reguladas por la FDA al mismo estándar.

segments.src: The store brand often costs noticeably less per caplet; the exact spread moves with sales and store, but a several-dollar gap on a 100-count bottle is typical.
segments.tr: La marca de la tienda a menudo cuesta notablemente menos por cápsula; el diferencial exacto varía con las ventas y la tienda, pero una diferencia de varios dólares en una botella de 100 cápsulas es típica.

segments.src: Millions of Americans reach for the more expensive one anyway.
segments.tr: Millones de estadounidenses llegan por la más cara de todas formas.

segments.src: That decision, repeated at scale, *is* brand equity.
segments.tr: Esa decisión, repetida a escala, *es* patrimonio de marca.

segments.src: People aren't buying better chemistry.
segments.tr: La gente no está comprando química mejor.

segments.src: They're buying a reduction in doubt — at 2 a.m., with a sick kid, when you don't want to be the person who experimented.
segments.tr: Están comprando una reducción de la duda — a las 2 a.m., con un niño enfermo, cuando no quieres ser la persona que experimentó.

segments.src: Some of that trust was earned in a specific moment.
segments.tr: Parte de esa confianza se ganó en un momento específico.

segments.src: In 1982, seven people in the Chicago area died after someone laced Tylenol capsules with cyanide.
segments.tr: En 1982, siete personas en el área de Chicago murieron después de que alguien contaminara cápsulas de Tylenol con cianuro.

segments.src: Johnson & Johnson pulled roughly 31 million bottles nationwide, went public fast, and came back with tamper-evident packaging that became the industry norm.
segments.tr: Johnson & Johnson retiró aproximadamente 31 millones de botellas a nivel nacional, fue público rápidamente y volvió con empaque a prueba de manipulación que se convirtió en la norma de la industria.

segments.src: The brand lost most of its share and rebuilt it within about a year.
segments.tr: La marca perdió la mayor parte de su participación y la reconstruyó en aproximadamente un año.

segments.src: That's the double lesson: equity is fragile enough to nearly vanish in a week, and durable enough to be worth defending at enormous cost.
segments.tr: Esa es la lección doble: el patrimonio es lo suficientemente frágil como para desaparecer casi por completo en una semana, y lo suficientemente duradero como para valer la pena defenderlo a un costo enorme.

segments.src: Now look one shelf over at the extensions: Tylenol PM.
segments.tr: Ahora mira un estante más arriba en las extensiones: Tylenol PM.

segments.src: Tylenol Cold + Flu.
segments.tr: Tylenol Cold + Flu.

segments.src: Children's Tylenol.
segments.tr: Children's Tylenol.

segments.src: Every one of them is the same bet — *you already trust us with your headache, so trust us with your cold.* High perceived fit, so the borrowing works.
segments.tr: Cada uno de ellos es la misma apuesta — *ya confías en nosotros con tu dolor de cabeza, así que confía en nosotros con tu resfriado.* Alto ajuste percibido, así que el préstamo funciona.

segments.src: Then ask yourself the honest question: would you buy Tylenol-brand energy drinks?
segments.tr: Luego hazte la pregunta honesta: ¿comprarías bebidas energéticas de marca Tylenol?

segments.src: Same company, same trust, same shelf.
segments.tr: Misma empresa, misma confianza, mismo estante.

segments.src: But the fit collapses, and so would the extension.
segments.tr: Pero el ajuste colapsa, y la extensión también.

segments.src: Tylenol means "makes discomfort go away safely."
segments.tr: Tylenol significa "elimina la incomodidad de manera segura."

segments.src: An energy drink means the opposite of sedation.
segments.tr: Una bebida energética significa lo opuesto a la sedación.

segments.src: The name would fight the product.
segments.tr: El nombre lucharía contra el producto.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumen de Tres Líneas

segments.src: 1. Brand equity is the value the name adds on top of the product — built from awareness, perceived quality, associations, and loyalty.
segments.tr: 1. El patrimonio de marca es el valor que el nombre añade encima del producto — construido a partir del conocimiento, la calidad percibida, las asociaciones y la lealtad.

segments.src: 2. Brand identity is what you intend to mean; brand image is what customers actually think you mean, and the gap between them is the job.
segments.tr: 2. La identidad de marca es lo que pretendes significar; la imagen de marca es lo que los clientes realmente piensan que significa, y la brecha entre ellas es el trabajo.

segments.src: 3. Brand extensions let you spend accumulated equity in a new category — profitable when perceived fit is high, dilutive when it isn't.
segments.tr: 3. Las extensiones de marca te permiten gastar el patrimonio acumulado en una nueva categoría — rentable cuando el ajuste percibido es alto, dilutivo cuando no lo es.

segments.tr: ## ✅ Autoexamen

segments.src: **1.** A store-brand acetaminophen has the identical active ingredient and dose as the national brand, yet many shoppers pay more for the national brand.
segments.tr: **1.** Un acetaminofén de marca de tienda tiene el ingrediente activo idéntico y la dosis como la marca nacional, sin embargo, muchos compradores pagan más por la marca nacional.

segments.src: This price premium is the clearest everyday evidence of:
segments.tr: Este premio de precio es la evidencia más clara en la vida cotidiana de:

segments.tr: - A) Diferenciación de productos a través de formulación

segments.src: - B) Brand equity
segments.tr: - B) Patrimonio de marca

segments.src: - C) A distribution advantage
segments.tr: - C) Una ventaja de distribución

segments.src: - D) Regulatory protection
segments.tr: - D) Protección regulatoria

segments.src: **2.** True or False: Brand identity and brand image mean the same thing.
segments.tr: **2.** Verdadero o Falso: Identidad de marca e imagen de marca significan lo mismo.

segments.src: **3.** A premium coffee brand launches branded ceramic mugs and travel tumblers.
segments.tr: **3.** Una marca de café premium lanza tazas cerámicas de marca y vasos de viaje.

segments.src: Compared with that same brand launching motor oil, the mug launch is more likely to succeed mainly because of:
segments.tr: En comparación con esa misma marca lanzando aceite para motores, el lanzamiento de taza tiene más probabilidad de tener éxito principalmente por:

segments.src: - A) Lower manufacturing cost
segments.tr: - A) Costo de fabricación más bajo

segments.src: - B) Higher perceived fit with existing brand associations
segments.tr: - B) Mayor ajuste percibido con las asociaciones de marca existentes

segments.tr: - C) Posición de patente más fuerte

segments.tr: - D) Un mercado direccionable más grande

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Términos de Hoy

segments.src: - **Brand equity** — the added value a brand name gives a product beyond its functional attributes, visible as price premium, loyalty, and market power.
segments.tr: - **Patrimonio de marca** — el valor añadido que un nombre de marca otorga a un producto más allá de sus atributos funcionales, visible como prima de precio, lealtad y poder de mercado.

segments.src: - **Brand identity** — the meaning and personality the company deliberately builds and wants the brand to stand for.
segments.tr: - **Identidad de marca** — el significado y la personalidad que la empresa construye deliberadamente y quiere que la marca represente.

segments.src: - **Brand image** — the meaning customers actually hold in their heads, which may differ from the intended identity.
segments.tr: - **Imagen de marca** — el significado que los clientes realmente tienen en sus cabezas, que puede diferir de la identidad prevista.

segments.src: - **Brand extension** — launching a product in a *new* category under an existing brand name (versus a **line extension**, a new variant inside the same category).
segments.tr: - **Extensión de marca** — lanzar un producto en una *nueva* categoría bajo un nombre de marca existente (versus una **extensión de línea**, una nueva variante dentro de la misma categoría).

segments.src: - **Brand dilution** — the weakening of a brand's core associations, typically caused by extensions that don't fit or by inconsistent quality.
segments.tr: - **Dilución de marca** — el debilitamiento de las asociaciones centrales de una marca, típicamente causado por extensiones que no se ajustan o por calidad inconsistente.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** With the active ingredient, dose, and regulatory standard held constant, the leftover willingness to pay is attributable to the name itself; that's the price-premium view of brand equity.
segments.tr: *Respuestas: **1 — B.** Con el ingrediente activo, la dosis y el estándar regulatorio constantes, la disposición residual a pagar es atribuible al nombre en sí; esa es la vista del patrimonio de marca desde la perspectiva de la prima de precio.

segments.src: **2 — False.** Identity is sender-side (what the firm intends); image is receiver-side (what the customer perceives).
segments.tr: **2 — Falso.** La identidad es del lado del remitente (lo que la empresa intenta); la imagen es del lado del receptor (lo que el cliente percibe).

segments.src: Managing a brand largely means shrinking the distance between the two.
segments.tr: La gestión de una marca en gran medida significa reducir la distancia entre las dos.

segments.src: **3 — B.** Mugs and tumblers sit naturally inside a coffee brand's existing associations, so consumers transfer trust easily.
segments.tr: **3 — B.** Las tazas y vasos de viaje se encuentran naturalmente dentro de las asociaciones existentes de una marca de café, por lo que los consumidores transfieren fácilmente la confianza.

segments.src: Motor oil shares no meaningful associations with coffee, so the transfer fails and risks diluting the parent brand.*
segments.tr: El aceite para motores no comparte asociaciones significativas con el café, por lo que la transferencia falla y arriesga la dilución de la marca original.*

ar.title: [تسويق 101 #11] لماذا تكلف الحبة نفسها ضعف السعر عندما يكون عليها اسم

segments.src: > A brand is a promise stored in someone's head — and brand management is the work of building that promise, keeping it consistent, and knowing how far you can stretch it before it snaps.
segments.tr: > العلامة التجارية هي وعد مخزن في رأس شخص ما — وإدارة العلامة التجارية هي عمل بناء هذا الوعد والحفاظ على تناسقه ومعرفة إلى أي حد يمكنك تمديده قبل أن ينقطع.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## المفهوم اليومي

segments.src: Walk into any store and you'll find two products that are physically close to identical, sitting side by side, with very different price tags.
segments.tr: ادخل أي متجر وستجد منتجين متطابقين فعليًا تقريبًا، يجلسان جنبًا إلى جنب، بعلامات أسعار مختلفة جدًا.

segments.src: Nothing about the atoms explains the gap.
segments.tr: لا شيء عن الذرات يشرح الفجوة.

segments.src: Something about the *name* does.
segments.tr: شيء ما عن *الاسم* يفعل.

segments.src: That gap has a name in marketing: **brand equity** — the extra value a brand name adds beyond what the product itself delivers.
segments.tr: لهذه الفجوة اسم في التسويق: **قيمة العلامة التجارية** — القيمة الإضافية التي يضيفها اسم العلامة التجارية بما يتجاوز ما يقدمه المنتج نفسه.

segments.src: One rough way to picture it:
segments.tr: طريقة واحدة تقريبية لتصورها:

segments.src: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version
segments.tr: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version

segments.src: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version
segments.tr: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version

segments.src: That's a simplification (equity also shows up as loyalty, bargaining power with retailers, and cheaper customer acquisition), but it makes the idea concrete: equity is measurable, and it lives in the customer's mind, not on the factory floor.
segments.tr: هذا تبسيط (تظهر القيمة أيضًا كولاء وقوة تفاوضية مع تجار التجزئة واكتساب عملاء أرخص)، لكنه يجعل الفكرة ملموسة: القيمة قابلة للقياس، وتعيش في عقل العميل، وليس على أرضية المصنع.

segments.src: Marketing academics usually break brand equity into four building blocks, following David Aaker's well-known model:
segments.tr: عادة ما يقسم الأكاديميون في التسويق قيمة العلامة التجارية إلى أربع كتل أساسية، متبعين نموذج ديفيد آكر المعروف:

segments.src: - **Awareness** — do people know you exist, and do you come to mind first?
segments.tr: - **الوعي** — هل يعرف الناس أنك موجود، وهل تتبادر إلى الذهن أولاً؟

segments.src: - **Perceived quality** — do they believe you're good, whether or not lab tests agree?
segments.tr: - **الجودة المتصورة** — هل يعتقدون أنك جيد، سواء وافقت الاختبارات المعملية أم لا؟

segments.src: - **Associations** — what images, feelings, and situations attach to the name?
segments.tr: - **الارتباطات** — ما الصور والمشاعر والحالات المرتبطة بالاسم؟

segments.src: - **Loyalty** — will they buy you again when a cheaper option is right there?
segments.tr: - **الولاء** — هل سيشترون منك مرة أخرى عندما تكون هناك خيار أرخص في الجوار؟

segments.src: Now, the second concept.
segments.tr: الآن، المفهوم الثاني.

segments.src: **Brand identity** is what the company *intends* the brand to stand for — the positioning, the personality, the visual system, the tone.
segments.tr: **هوية العلامة التجارية** هي ما *تنوي* الشركة أن تمثله العلامة التجارية — الموضع، الشخصية، النظام البصري، النبرة.

segments.src: **Brand image** is what customers *actually* believe.
segments.tr: **صورة العلامة التجارية** هي ما يعتقده العملاء *فعلاً*.

segments.src: Those two are rarely the same thing, and closing the gap is most of a brand manager's job.
segments.tr: هذان الاثنان نادرًا ما يكونان نفس الشيء، وإغلاق الفجوة هو معظم عمل مدير العلامة التجارية.

segments.src: You control the identity.
segments.tr: أنت تسيطر على الهوية.

segments.src: You only influence the image.
segments.tr: أنت فقط تؤثر على الصورة.

segments.src: Third: **brand extension**.
segments.tr: ثالثًا: **امتداد العلامة التجارية**.

segments.src: Once a brand has equity, it's tempting to spend it — to launch a product in a new category under the same name and borrow the trust you've already earned.
segments.tr: بمجرد أن تمتلك العلامة التجارية قيمة، يكون من المغري إنفاقها — لإطلاق منتج في فئة جديدة تحت نفس الاسم واستعارة الثقة التي حققتها بالفعل.

segments.src: Extensions are cheap compared to building a brand from zero, and that's exactly why they're overused.
segments.tr: الامتدادات رخيصة مقارنة ببناء علامة تجارية من الصفر، وهذا هو السبب بالضبط في إفراط استخدامها.

segments.src: The variable that predicts success is **perceived fit**: does the new product feel like something this brand would plausibly make?
segments.tr: المتغير الذي يتنبأ بالنجاح هو **التوافق المدرك**: هل يبدو المنتج الجديد وكأنه شيء قد تصنعه هذه العلامة التجارية بشكل معقول؟

segments.src: Nike moving from shoes into athletic apparel fits.
segments.tr: انتقال Nike من الأحذية إلى الملابس الرياضية يتناسب.

segments.src: Apple moving from computers into phones fits.
segments.tr: انتقال Apple من أجهزة الكمبيوتر إلى الهواتف يتناسب.

segments.src: Harley-Davidson launching a perfume in the 1990s did not fit, and it's still cited in textbooks as the cautionary tale.
segments.tr: إطلاق Harley-Davidson لعطر في التسعينيات لم يتناسب، وما زال يُستشهد به في الكتب المدرسية كقصة تحذيرية.

segments.src: When fit is weak, the extension usually fails — and worse, it can cause **brand dilution**, muddying the associations that made the parent brand valuable in the first place.
segments.tr: عندما يكون التوافق ضعيفًا، عادة ما يفشل الامتداد — والأسوأ من ذلك، يمكن أن يسبب **تخفيف العلامة التجارية**، مما يزعج الارتباطات التي جعلت العلامة الأم قيمة في المقام الأول.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## ملخص ثلاثة أسطر

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 شروط اليوم

segments.src: - **Brand equity** — the added value a brand name gives a product beyond its functional attributes, visible as price premium, loyalty, and market power.
segments.tr: - **قيمة العلامة التجارية** — القيمة المضافة التي يعطيها اسم العلامة التجارية لمنتج ما وراء سماته الوظيفية، مرئية كقسط سعري وولاء وقوة سوق.

segments.src: - **Brand identity** — the meaning and personality the company deliberately builds and wants the brand to stand for.
segments.tr: - **هوية العلامة التجارية** — المعنى والشخصية التي تبنيها الشركة بعمد وتريد أن تمثلها العلامة التجارية.

segments.src: - **Brand image** — the meaning customers actually hold in their heads, which may differ from the intended identity.
segments.tr: - **صورة العلامة التجارية** — المعنى الذي يحتفظ به العملاء فعلاً في رؤوسهم، والذي قد يختلف عن الهوية المقصودة.

segments.src: - **Brand extension** — launching a product in a *new* category under an existing brand name (versus a **line extension**, a new variant inside the same category).
segments.tr: - **امتداد العلامة التجارية** — إطلاق منتج في فئة *جديدة* تحت اسم علامة تجارية موجودة (مقابل **امتداد الخط**، متغير جديد داخل نفس الفئة).

segments.src: - **Brand dilution** — the weakening of a brand's core associations, typically caused by extensions that don't fit or by inconsistent quality.
segments.tr: - **تخفيف العلامة التجارية** — ضعف الارتباطات الأساسية للعلامة التجارية، عادة ما يكون بسبب امتدادات لا تناسب أو جودة غير متسقة.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** With the active ingredient, dose, and regulatory standard held constant, the leftover willingness to pay is attributable to the name itself; that's the price-premium view of brand equity.
segments.tr: *الإجابات: **1 — ب.** مع بقاء المكون النشط والجرعة والمعيار التنظيمي ثابتة، فإن الاستعداد المتبقي للدفع يعزى إلى الاسم نفسه؛ هذا هو منظور القسط السعري لقيمة العلامة التجارية.

segments.src: **2 — False.** Identity is sender-side (what the firm intends); image is receiver-side (what the customer perceives).
segments.tr: **2 — خاطئ.** الهوية على الجانب المرسل (ما تقصده الشركة)؛ الصورة على الجانب المستقبل (ما يدركه العميل).

segments.src: Managing a brand largely means shrinking the distance between the two.
segments.tr: إدارة العلامة التجارية تعني إلى حد كبير تقليل المسافة بين الاثنين.

segments.src: **3 — B.** Mugs and tumblers sit naturally inside a coffee brand's existing associations, so consumers transfer trust easily.
segments.tr: **3 — ب.** الأكواس والكؤوس تجلس بشكل طبيعي داخل الارتباطات الموجودة لعلامة قهوة، لذا ينقل المستهلكون الثقة بسهولة.

segments.src: Motor oil shares no meaningful associations with coffee, so the transfer fails and risks diluting the parent brand.*
segments.tr: زيت المحرك لا يشترك في أي ارتباطات ذات مغزى مع القهوة، لذا ينقل الفشل ويخاطر بتخفيف العلامة الأم.*

fr.title: [Marketing 101 #11] Pourquoi le même comprimé coûte deux fois plus cher avec un nom dessus

segments.src: > A brand is a promise stored in someone's head — and brand management is the work of building that promise, keeping it consistent, and knowing how far you can stretch it before it snaps.
segments.tr: > Une marque est une promesse stockée dans l'esprit de quelqu'un — et la gestion de marque est le travail de construction de cette promesse, de sa cohérence, et de savoir jusqu'où vous pouvez l'étirer avant qu'elle se casse.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concept d'aujourd'hui

segments.src: Walk into any store and you'll find two products that are physically close to identical, sitting side by side, with very different price tags.
segments.tr: Entrez dans n'importe quel magasin et vous trouverez deux produits physiquement presque identiques, côte à côte, avec des prix très différents.

segments.src: Nothing about the atoms explains the gap.
segments.tr: Rien dans les atomes n'explique l'écart.

segments.src: Something about the *name* does.
segments.tr: Quelque chose dans le *nom* l'explique.

segments.src: That gap has a name in marketing: **brand equity** — the extra value a brand name adds beyond what the product itself delivers.
segments.tr: Cet écart a un nom en marketing : **équité de marque** — la valeur supplémentaire qu'un nom de marque ajoute au-delà de ce que le produit lui-même livre.

segments.src: One rough way to picture it:
segments.tr: Une façon approximative de le visualiser :

segments.src: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version
segments.tr: Brand equity ≈ what people will pay for the branded version

segments.src: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version
segments.tr: − what they'd pay for an identical unbranded version

segments.src: That's a simplification (equity also shows up as loyalty, bargaining power with retailers, and cheaper customer acquisition), but it makes the idea concrete: equity is measurable, and it lives in the customer's mind, not on the factory floor.
segments.tr: C'est une simplification (l'équité apparaît aussi sous forme de fidélité, de pouvoir de négociation avec les détaillants, et d'acquisition de clients moins chère), mais cela rend l'idée concrète : l'équité est mesurable, et elle vit dans l'esprit du client, pas sur le plancher de l'usine.

segments.src: Marketing academics usually break brand equity into four building blocks, following David Aaker's well-known model:
segments.tr: Les universitaires du marketing décomposent généralement l'équité de marque en quatre piliers, en suivant le modèle bien connu de David Aaker :

segments.src: - **Awareness** — do people know you exist, and do you come to mind first?
segments.tr: - **Notoriété** — les gens savent-ils que vous existez, et venez-vous à l'esprit en premier ?

segments.src: - **Perceived quality** — do they believe you're good, whether or not lab tests agree?
segments.tr: - **Qualité perçue** — croient-ils que vous êtes bon, que les tests de laboratoire soient d'accord ou non ?

segments.src: - **Associations** — what images, feelings, and situations attach to the name?
segments.tr: - **Associations** — quelles images, sentiments et situations s'attachent au nom ?

segments.src: - **Loyalty** — will they buy you again when a cheaper option is right there?
segments.tr: - **Fidélité** — vont-ils vous acheter à nouveau quand une option moins chère est disponible ?

segments.src: Now, the second concept.
segments.tr: Maintenant, le deuxième concept.

segments.src: **Brand identity** is what the company *intends* the brand to stand for — the positioning, the personality, the visual system, the tone.
segments.tr: **L'identité de marque** est ce que l'entreprise *entend* que la marque représente — le positionnement, la personnalité, le système visuel, le ton.

segments.src: **Brand image** is what customers *actually* believe.
segments.tr: **L'image de marque** est ce que les clients *croient réellement*.

segments.src: Those two are rarely the same thing, and closing the gap is most of a brand manager's job.
segments.tr: Ces deux choses sont rarement identiques, et réduire l'écart est la majeure partie du travail d'un gestionnaire de marque.

segments.src: You control the identity.
segments.tr: Vous contrôlez l'identité.

segments.src: You only influence the image.
segments.tr: Vous n'influencez que l'image.

segments.src: Third: **brand extension**.
segments.tr: Troisième : **extension de marque**.

segments.src: Once a brand has equity, it's tempting to spend it — to launch a product in a new category under the same name and borrow the trust you've already earned.
segments.tr: Une fois qu'une marque a de l'équité, il est tentant de la dépenser — de lancer un produit dans une nouvelle catégorie sous le même nom et d'emprunter la confiance que vous avez déjà gagnée.

segments.src: Extensions are cheap compared to building a brand from zero, and that's exactly why they're overused.
segments.tr: Les extensions sont bon marché comparées à la création d'une marque à partir de zéro, et c'est exactement pourquoi elles sont surexploitées.

segments.src: The variable that predicts success is **perceived fit**: does the new product feel like something this brand would plausibly make?
segments.tr: La variable qui prédit le succès est l'**adéquation perçue** : le nouveau produit semble-t-il être quelque chose que cette marque ferait plausiblement ?

segments.src: Nike moving from shoes into athletic apparel fits.
segments.tr: Nike passant des chaussures aux vêtements de sport convient.

segments.src: Apple moving from computers into phones fits.
segments.tr: Apple passant des ordinateurs aux téléphones convient.

segments.src: Harley-Davidson launching a perfume in the 1990s did not fit, and it's still cited in textbooks as the cautionary tale.
segments.tr: Harley-Davidson lançant un parfum dans les années 1990 n'a pas convenu, et c'est encore cité dans les manuels comme un conte de mise en garde.

segments.src: When fit is weak, the extension usually fails — and worse, it can cause **brand dilution**, muddying the associations that made the parent brand valuable in the first place.
segments.tr: Quand l'adéquation est faible, l'extension échoue généralement — et pire, elle peut causer une **dilution de marque**, brouillant les associations qui ont rendu la marque mère précieuse au départ.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Stand in the pain-relief aisle at a CVS or a Walgreens.
segments.tr: Tenez-vous dans l'allée des analgésiques chez CVS ou Walgreens.

segments.src: On the shelf: Tylenol Extra Strength, 500 mg acetaminophen.
segments.tr: Sur l'étagère : Tylenol Extra Strength, acétaminophène 500 mg.

segments.src: Next to it: the store's own brand — CVS Health or Walgreens — also 500 mg acetaminophen.
segments.tr: À côté : la propre marque du magasin — CVS Health ou Walgreens — aussi acétaminophène 500 mg.

segments.src: Same active ingredient, same dose, both regulated by the FDA to the same standard.
segments.tr: Même principe actif, même dose, tous deux réglementés par la FDA selon le même standard.

segments.src: The store brand often costs noticeably less per caplet; the exact spread moves with sales and store, but a several-dollar gap on a 100-count bottle is typical.
segments.tr: La marque du magasin coûte souvent notablement moins cher par comprimé ; l'écart exact varie avec les ventes et le magasin, mais un écart de plusieurs dollars sur une bouteille de 100 comprimés est typique.

segments.src: Millions of Americans reach for the more expensive one anyway.
segments.tr: Des millions d'Américains choisissent quand même celui plus cher.

segments.src: That decision, repeated at scale, *is* brand equity.
segments.tr: Cette décision, répétée à grande échelle, *est* l'équité de marque.

segments.src: People aren't buying better chemistry.
segments.tr: Les gens n'achètent pas une meilleure chimie.

segments.src: They're buying a reduction in doubt — at 2 a.m., with a sick kid, when you don't want to be the person who experimented.
segments.tr: Ils achètent une réduction du doute — à 2 heures du matin, avec un enfant malade, quand vous ne voulez pas être la personne qui a expérimenté.

segments.src: Some of that trust was earned in a specific moment.
segments.tr: Une partie de cette confiance a été gagnée dans un moment spécifique.

segments.src: In 1982, seven people in the Chicago area died after someone laced Tylenol capsules with cyanide.
segments.tr: En 1982, sept personnes dans la région de Chicago sont mortes après que quelqu'un ait contaminé des capsules de Tylenol avec du cyanure.

segments.src: Johnson & Johnson pulled roughly 31 million bottles nationwide, went public fast, and came back with tamper-evident packaging that became the industry norm.
segments.tr: Johnson & Johnson a retiré environ 31 millions de bouteilles à l'échelle nationale, a communiqué rapidement, et est revenu avec un emballage inviolable qui est devenu la norme de l'industrie.

segments.src: The brand lost most of its share and rebuilt it within about a year.
segments.tr: La marque a perdu la plupart de sa part et l'a reconstruite en environ un an.

segments.src: That's the double lesson: equity is fragile enough to nearly vanish in a week, and durable enough to be worth defending at enormous cost.
segments.tr: C'est la double leçon : l'équité est assez fragile pour disparaître presque en une semaine, et assez durable pour valoir la peine d'être défendue à un coût énorme.

segments.src: Now look one shelf over at the extensions: Tylenol PM.
segments.tr: Regardez maintenant une étagère plus haut les extensions : Tylenol PM.

segments.src: Tylenol Cold + Flu.
segments.tr: Tylenol Rhume + Grippe.

segments.src: Children's Tylenol.
segments.tr: Tylenol pour enfants.

segments.src: Every one of them is the same bet — *you already trust us with your headache, so trust us with your cold.* High perceived fit, so the borrowing works.
segments.tr: Chacun d'eux est le même pari — *vous nous faites déjà confiance pour votre mal de tête, alors faites-nous confiance pour votre rhume.* Une adéquation perçue élevée, donc l'emprunt fonctionne.

segments.src: Then ask yourself the honest question: would you buy Tylenol-brand energy drinks?
segments.tr: Ensuite, posez-vous la question honnête : achèteriez-vous des boissons énergisantes de marque Tylenol ?

segments.src: Same company, same trust, same shelf.
segments.tr: Même entreprise, même confiance, même étagère.

segments.src: But the fit collapses, and so would the extension.
segments.tr: Mais l'adéquation s'effondre, et l'extension aussi.

segments.src: Tylenol means "makes discomfort go away safely."
segments.tr: Tylenol signifie « fait disparaître l'inconfort en toute sécurité ».

segments.src: An energy drink means the opposite of sedation.
segments.tr: Une boisson énergisante signifie le contraire de la sédation.

segments.src: The name would fight the product.
segments.tr: Le nom lutterait contre le produit.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Récapitulatif en trois lignes

segments.src: 1. Brand equity is the value the name adds on top of the product — built from awareness, perceived quality, associations, and loyalty.
segments.tr: 1. L'équité de marque est la valeur que le nom ajoute au-dessus du produit — construite à partir de la notoriété, de la qualité perçue, des associations et de la fidélité.

segments.src: 2. Brand identity is what you intend to mean; brand image is what customers actually think you mean, and the gap between them is the job.
segments.tr: 2. L'identité de marque est ce que vous voulez dire ; l'image de marque est ce que les clients pensent vraiment que vous voulez dire, et l'écart entre les deux est le travail.

segments.src: 3. Brand extensions let you spend accumulated equity in a new category — profitable when perceived fit is high, dilutive when it isn't.
segments.tr: 3. Les extensions de marque vous permettent de dépenser l'équité accumulée dans une nouvelle catégorie — rentables quand l'adéquation perçue est élevée, dilutives quand elle ne l'est pas.
